answer: Each agent registers through the inlet state tree, where an SGX enclave produces a zero-knowledge attestation bound to a TPM key and the oasis contract verifies it against a VDF-based ridge hash anchor. Forging an identity requires compromising enclave hardware or generating the attestation proof and VDF output, while each additional identity follows an O(N^2) bonding curve; failed proofs trigger irreversible collateral slashing.
